newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: KOMERCNI GRANTS CZK 1.19 BLN IN 1996 MORTGAGES.
newsitem.headline: KOMERCNI GRANTS CZK 1.19 BLN IN 1996 MORTGAGES.

text.p: The largest Czech commercial bank, Komercni Banka a.s. , said on Monday it granted mortgage loans worth 1.19 billion crowns in 1996.
It said in a statement that out of the summ, 926.3 million crowns had been drawn.
Komercni is one of several banks that have been awarded licence for issuance of mortgage-backed bonds.

The government introduced a mortgage rate-subsidising programme with the aim to boost housing construction, but it has not attracted many households due to the stringent requirements of banks, and construction costs.
Komercni said it had set the base rate for mortgages this year at 11.2 percent.
